basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, majoring in digital media. Recently got into Reddit to explore gaming communities and share my enthusiasm for indie games like Bug Fables. In my spare time, I love off-roading with my Jeep and tinkering with DIY projects. Usually online late evenings after classes and during weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom of student life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming through hours of gameplay and streaming. Growing up, I loved watching my older siblings play, and now I combine that passion with my studies in digital media. Recently started learning about car maintenance and DIY through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
